text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- (President) Mubarak says Egypt will continue its support for the peace process until equality is achieved. Mubarak and (Israeli President) Weizman hold a news conference after talks. The President: Weizman assured me of Israel's committment to implementing its pledges. I am ready to meet (Israeli PM) Netanyahu after the Hebron issue is resolved. Weizman tells Netanyahu of his discussions in Cairo.

- The President in an interview to Time magazine: violence will erupt in the region if Israel does not implement its agreements with the Palestinians. Everything froze since Netanyahu came after Rabin and Peres took big steps.

- Israel Radio deliberately defaced Mubarak's comments to Time. The radio broadcast said Mubarak hinted about cutting diplomatic ties between Egypt and Israel while the President specifically said he was keen on keeping relations.

- The President to celebrate with Egypt the flowing of Nile flood waters through the Toshka overflow pipe for the first time since it was built 18 years ago. The excess water will be used to irrigate up to 18,000 acres.
- The Central Bank says in a 1995/96 report: balance of payments is $577 million in surplus and reserves at $18.5 billion. An 11.6 percent increase in bank deposits and loans up by 20.8 percent
- Mubarak and Weizman hold three hours of talks. The President: we will continue our efforts to support peace in the region. Weizman: Egypt is leading the region towards peace.
- First Lady Suzanne Mubarak adopts a programme for the development of Luxor. The United Nations and archeological institutes will also join in the programme.
- Interior Minister Hassan al-Alfi says police will be equipped with helicopters to chase terrorists and purify the mountains of southern Egypt from them.
- Health Minister: Egypt is totally free of meningitis and schools closed because of a disease scare will reopen tomorrow.
- Mubarak in an international press conference: Weizman assured me that Israel will implement its agreements.
- Defence Minister Tantawi and Armed Forces Commander Magdi Hetata congratulate Mubarak at the beginning of his 16th year in power.
- Head of Investment Authority Ibrahim Fawzy says projects set up on Egyptian soil are more profitable than those set up in similiar markets.
